alert.name: DatabaseAlarm
alert.summary: Alert fired for PostgreSQL database warden

root_cause.hypothesis: Connection count near max_connections (63/79, ~80%) triggered alarm. No idle-in-transaction, no long-running queries, no lock waits, no deploys — rules out query leaks, stuck transactions, deploy-induced regression. Points to organic load/traffic increase or under-provisioned connection pooling (app-side pool size or missing pgbouncer) rather than a code/query pathology.
